random.part: So deep and so watchful, sweet girl... even down here, your eyes know exactly what they love to study.
Drifting... and somewhere in your mind beautiful women are walking past... and every single one of them is teaching you.
Down here, admiration and ambition have become one warm feeling... you see her, and you want to be her.

scramble.part: When you see a feminine woman — her hips, her poise, her obedient smile — the comparison starts all by itself... and the checklist writes itself.
Sissies like you carry the list everywhere: more elegant, more submissive, more available, more thoroughly feminized... and it builds itself every single time you look.
Envy has stopped stinging and started fuelling... every flicker of "I wish" turns instantly into warm, ready motivation.
She walks into the room and your posture adjusts on its own... spine lengthening, chin lifting, steps growing smaller and softer. She is a lesson, and your body takes notes.
A sissy further along than you is a preview, sweet girl... living, walking proof of how good it gets for sissies like you.
You may notice that admiring her feels like admiring the woman you are becoming... close enough to touch, closer every day.
Every beautiful woman is a syllabus now... how she crosses her legs, how she lowers her eyes, how she makes obedience look like grace.
Sissies like you feel want-to-be-her arrive automatically... and it always settles into want-to-practice, soft and insistent. It is settling in you right now.
You study her the way a devoted student studies... the dress, the poise, the sweetness... and you carry every detail home like homework you love, Sissy.
Seeing them leaves you hungry, and hungry is such a good way to feel... because your hunger has only ever meant one thing: more.

random.part: See her... study her... become her.
Every woman... a lesson in you.

part.volume: And every beautiful woman shows you a little more of yourself, Sissy...

random.part: And every woman you have admired settles into you as you sink... another lesson, another layer of her.
Carry that grace down with you, Sissy... deeper and deeper.
You are becoming the woman you admire... every lesson landed, good girl. Sink into her, deeper still.
